Companion Animal Travel Desk Procedures

This section sets the standard for safe and respectful handling of companion animals at Aurelia Skyways. Staff must review each booking for species, temperament, carrier condition, and passenger readiness before acceptance. The desk shall confirm that the animal can be managed without distress and that all travel documents, feeding notes, and comfort items are complete. Care plans must reflect the animal's normal routine, and the desk must refuse any arrangement that cannot be handled safely by the available crew or facilities.

When a traveler presents an animal, the staff member shall speak calmly, keep the work area orderly, and avoid sudden movement or loud instruction. The animal must remain secured except when a controlled check is required. If an animal shows agitation, breathing difficulty, or signs of injury, the desk must pause the process and request immediate support from the appropriate service lead. Handlers shall never improvise a substitute restraint or ignore visible stress. Cleanliness is mandatory, and any spill, odor, or waste must be addressed at once to protect other travelers and staff.

<<FACT F008>> The desk shall record the applicable holding instructions, verify the routing note, and make sure the traveler understands the handoff sequence before departure. Where a pet relief stop is involved, staff must direct the traveler only to the approved access point and remind the handler to keep the animal leashed or otherwise secured. <<FACT F016>> The route must be monitored for delays, and any change that may affect welfare requires prompt review by the supervisor. Aurelia Skyways expects dependable companion travel, and every employee must support that standard without exception.

For any uncertainty, contact the senior coordinator through the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
